title: Perfect Vulkan
description: Massive fps booster built on the Vulkan API.
body:
This modpack is by far the best available collection of mods to boost your frames based on the Vulkan render API. This modpack has been tested quite a bit against other top-tier modpacks on various systems of mine and has come out on top.                                                                                
This modpack achieved **1600** avg frames in 1080p on an i38145U(it didnt even have thermal paste lmfao). The modpack has been created in search of pure frame performance, validifying the tradeoff of switching to vulkan causing compatibility issues
